name: component-expansion-derived-property-resolves-on-a-fluid-stream
source:
COMPONENT Sink(in)
  PARAM fluid$ = Water
  drain = in.mdot
END
Sink K1(a, fluid$=R134a)
a.P = 200000
a.x = 1

error.message: There are 3 equations and 4 variables. The problem is underspecified and cannot be solved. Free quantity (no defining relation): k1.drain. Coupled to: a.mdot. A common cause: an element chain with no constitutive law for that quantity — e.g. an efficiency-only machine or rigid pass-through between boundaries leaves its through-flow or a port pressure free; add an orifice/valve/flow-map element or pin a boundary value.
